prompt: In parallelogram $ABCD$, side $\overline{AB}$ has length $3x + 2$ and the opposite side $\overline{CD}$ has length $17$. What is the value of $x$?
hint: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are congruent, so those two expressions are equal.

hints.text: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are congruent, so those two expressions are equal.

explanation: Opposite sides of a parallelogram have equal length: $3x + 2 = 17$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Geometry sets it up, algebra finishes it
steps: The geometry fact does one job: it turns a picture into the equation $3x + 2 = 17$.
From there it is an ordinary two-step equation — peel off the $+2$, then undo the $\times 3$.
